description: This Java class 'RepaymentPeriod' models a period within a loan repayment schedule, including interest periods, EMI calculations, paid amounts, and outstanding balances. It provides methods for creating, copying, and calculating various financial metrics related to loan repayment periods.

classes.name: RepaymentPeriod
classes.description: Represents a scheduled period for loan repayment, including interest periods, EMI, paid amounts, and balance calculations.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty RepaymentPeriod with no interest periods or amounts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RepaymentPeriod with specified dates, EMI, and interest periods.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing RepaymentPeriod, including interest periods.

methods.name: copyWithoutPaidAmounts
methods.description: Creates a copy of a RepaymentPeriod with paid amounts reset to zero.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous repayment period, if any.

methods.name: getRateFactorPlus1
methods.description: Calculates the sum of (Rate Factor + 1) from interest periods.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorPlus1
methods.description: Performs the actual calculation for getRateFactorPlus1.

methods.name: getCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Returns the total due interest including unrecognized interest.

methods.name: calculateCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Calculates the total due interest, considering interest movement and previous periods.

methods.name: getDueInterest
methods.description: Returns the interest amount due or paid, whichever is higher.

methods.name: getEmiPlusCreditedAmountsPlusFutureUnrecognizedInterest
methods.description: Returns EMI plus credited amounts and future unrecognized interest.

methods.name: getCalculatedDuePrincipal
methods.description: Calculates principal due based on EMI and interest.

methods.name: getCreditedPrincipal
methods.description: Sum of all credited principal amounts in interest periods.

methods.name: getCreditedInterest
methods.description: Sum of all credited interest amounts in interest periods.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomePrincipal
methods.description: Sum of capitalized income principals in interest periods.

methods.name: getDuePrincipal
methods.description: Principal amount due or paid, considering early repayment.

methods.name: getTotalCreditedAmount
methods.description: Sum of credited principal and interest.

methods.name: getTotalPaidAmount
methods.description: Sum of paid principal and interest.

methods.name: isFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the total paid amount equals EMI plus unrecognized interest.

methods.name: getUnrecognizedInterest
methods.description: Interest amounts not yet recognized in EMI.

methods.name: getCreditedAmounts
methods.description: Total credited amounts in interest periods.

methods.name: getOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Calculates the outstanding loan balance at the end of the period.

methods.name: addPaidPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds to the total paid principal.

methods.name: addPaidInterestAmount
methods.description: Adds to the total paid interest.

methods.name: getInitialBalanceForEmiRecalculation
methods.description: Calculates initial balance for recalculating EMI.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns a zero Money object in the relevant currency.

methods.name: getFirstInterestPeriod
methods.description: Returns the first interest period.

methods.name: getLastInterestPeriod
methods.description: Returns the last interest period.

methods.name: findInterestPeriod
methods.description: Finds an interest period containing a specific date.

methods.name: isFirstRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Checks if this is the first repayment period.

methods.name: getOutstandingInterest
methods.description: Returns the outstanding interest amount.

methods.name: getOutstandingPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the outstanding principal amount.

methods.name: resetDerivedComponents
methods.description: Resets paid interest and principal to zero.

methods.name: calculateTotalDisbursedAndCapitalizedIncomeAmountTillGivenPeriod
methods.description: Calculates total disbursed and capitalized income amount up to a given interest period.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency used in the period.

methods.name: getEmi
methods.description: Returns the EMI amount, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getOriginalEmi
methods.description: Returns the original EMI amount, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getPaidPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the paid principal, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getPaidInterest
methods.description: Returns the paid interest, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getFutureUnrecognizedInterest
methods.description: Returns future unrecognized interest, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getTotalDisbursedAmount
methods.description: Returns total disbursed amount, defaulting to zero if null.

methods.name: getTotalCapitalizedIncomeAmount
methods.description: Returns total capitalized income amount, defaulting to zero if null.
